message:
As the clouds roll in and the wind starts to pick up, I can’t help but think of storms as an opportunity for a cozy little adventure at home. 🏡 It’s the perfect excuse to gather the family, turn on some warm lights, and maybe even bake a few cookies (yes, I will probably end up eating more dough than I should!).

I found a handy guide that walks you through how to prepare for those blustery days ahead. It’s all about creating a comfy plan so you can focus on making memories instead of worrying. 

What’s your favorite way to turn a stormy day into a cozy event?
